title: RNA extraction from Sterivex using phenol:chloroform for low biomass samples
author: Naomi Gilbert
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bh75j9q6
materials: Return Bashing bead lysis tube to ice.

steps.title: Prepare Solution A
steps.instruction: Prepare Solution A by mixing the following components:

substeps.instruction: 750 μL of 20% SDS
600 μL of 0.5M EDTA
200 μL of 3M sodium acetate
28.45 mL of nuclease free water

steps.title: Sterilize Equipment
steps.instruction: Decontaminate the workspace and tools to prevent RNase contamination.

substeps.instruction: Sterilize surface with 70% ethanol.
Flame forceps and razor blade/scalpel with ethanol.
Clean pliers with 70% ethanol and flame the metal portion.
Apply RNase decontaminating spray (e.g., RNase AWAY) to all equipment.

steps.title: Extract Filter from Sterivex Unit
steps.instruction: Remove the filter from the Sterivex casing using pliers and a sterile blade.

substeps.instruction: Hold the outward end of the Sterivex unit and squeeze the plastic with pliers all the way around the filter, nearest to that end, until the Sterivex pops out of the casing.
Use the sterile razor blade/scalpel to cut two vertical lines down opposite sides of the cylindrical filter (180 degrees apart).
Cut around the top and bottom of the cylindrical filter.
Using sterile forceps, peel the filter off the plastic in two pieces and fold it to fit into a bead beating tube (recommended: Zymo ZR BashingBead Lysis Tubes S6012-50).

steps.title: Lysis and Initial Bead Beating
steps.instruction: Perform initial lysis of the sample in the BashingBead tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µL of Solution A to the BashingBead lysis tube containing the filter.
Vortex the tube (optimize time and intensity on practice samples).
Briefly centrifuge the tubes to settle the liquid.
Add 500 µL acid phenol:chloroform:IAA (125:24:1; pH 4.8), ensuring the reagent is pulled from the bottom layer of the thawed mixture.
Beat on maximum speed for 40 s in a bead beater, then place on ice briefly to chill.
Spin at maximum speed in a 4 °C benchtop centrifuge for 5 minutes.
Transfer as much of the aqueous supernatant as possible to a new 2 mL centrifuge tube.
Optional: If a large white protein layer exists between the top and bottom layers, repeat the addition of 500 µL acid phenol:chloroform:IAA, vortex, centrifuge, and pool the supernatant.

steps.title: Chloroform Wash
steps.instruction: Remove residual phenol from the aqueous layer.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μL chloroform to the aqueous layer, vortex well, and spin at max speed for 5 min.
Repeat the chloroform extraction if necessary to remove residual phenol.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA using sodium acetate and ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add sodium acetate to reach a final concentration of ~0.3 M (e.g., add 50 μL of 3M NaAc for a 500 μL recovery) and mix.
Add 2-2.5x volumes of ice cold 100% ethanol (typically filling the rest of a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube) and mix well.
Place in a -80 °C freezer for at least 1 hr.
Spin at maximum speed at 0 °C for at least 30 min in a refrigerated centrifuge (increase to 1 hr if low yields are suspected).

steps.title: RNA Pellet Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet to remove salts.

substeps.instruction: Carefully decant 100% ethanol without disturbing the pellet.
Wash the pellet by adding 1 mL of ice cold 70% ethanol and gently pipetting up and down to dislodge the pellet.
Spin at maximum speed at 0 °C for 15 minutes (increase to 30 minutes if low yields are expected).

steps.title: Ethanol Removal and Drying
steps.instruction: Remove remaining ethanol and dry the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Gently aspirate as much 70% ethanol as possible using a small pipette tip, taking care not to disturb the pellet.
Place the open tube in a 37 °C heating block for 3-5 min to evaporate all ethanol (ideally in a sterile environment).

steps.title: RNA Dissolution
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final RNA pellet in nuclease-free water.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve the RNA pellet in the appropriate amount of RNAse/DNase-free water based on expected yields and desired final concentration.
